string.name: addon_delivery_mail_hint

string.value: Plain FTP is unencrypted. Usernames, passwords and file contents can be intercepted or altered. Use your own server on a trusted network only. The app does not scan or automatically delete local recordings. Limit: 512 MiB per recording.
